# LCARS

LCARS is a true-black LCARS interface with elbow-framed panels, pill geometry and a two-hue accent system that uses orange for structure and periwinkle for interactivity. It embeds Antonio for large headings and adds a standby console on New Tab, ribbon color-block sidebars, pill tags and console chrome. The theme honors the system reduce-motion setting and is locked to dark mode.

![LCARS screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cogito-ergo-video/lcars-inspired-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

    name:   "LCARS"
    author: "Thomas"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/cogito-ergo-video/lcars-inspired-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cogito-ergo-video/lcars-inspired-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a true-black LCARS interface with elbow-framed panels, pill geometry, and a restrained two-hue accent system—orange for structure, periwinkle for interactivity. Display embedded Antonio for large headings, a standby console on New Tab, ribbon color-block sidebars, pill tags and console chrome, honor system reduce-motion, and lock the theme to dark mode."
}
```
